methodology: Three fresh baseline/candidate process pairs, alternating order; nine samples per process. Ratios pair process medians. Observed ranges are not confidence intervals.

baseline.description: Exact published-runtime baseline before this optimization study; documentation differs from the npm archive.

candidate.description: Frozen candidate runtime measured against the published 0.1.2 baseline; source hashes identify the uncommitted candidate.

methodology.topology: MessageChannel, two endpoints in one event loop; worker startup/scheduling excluded
methodology.payload: Identical structured-cloned objects; every returned scalar/text checked; remote echo invocation counts verified after timing
methodology.order: Rotate library order each round; repeat this suite in fresh processes
methodology.guarantees: CrossBus retains default payload/request limits, peer binding and timeout. Comlink has no per-call timeout; birpc defaults to 60s; Penpal default has none, plus a cached 30s-timeout variant. API semantics differ.

methodology.order: one warmup, rotate library order per sample; repeat in fresh processes
methodology.callbacks: observable counter/checksum, identical callback semantics; local reference dispatch
methodology.warning: not serialization, byte throughput or cross-context RPC
